title: The First Conditional
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora sabes cómo hacer proyecciones y negociar usando el Primer Condicional.

parts.visual: Usamos el Primer Condicional para hablar de situaciones futuras posibles y reales. Estructura: IF + Present Simple, WILL + Verbo en forma base. (Si pasa esto, pasará aquello).
parts.audio: We use the First Conditional to talk about possible and real future situations. Structure: IF plus Present Simple, WILL plus the base verb. Meaning: If this happens, that will happen.

parts.visual: Ejemplos: If we reduce prices, we will sell more (Si reducimos los precios, venderemos más). If the client calls, I will answer (Si el cliente llama, yo responderé).
parts.audio: Examples: If we reduce prices, we will sell more. If the client calls, I will answer.

parts.visual: También puedes invertir el orden (sin usar coma). Ej: We will sell more if we reduce prices. Negativo: If we don't hurry, we will be late (Si no nos apuramos, llegaremos tarde).
parts.audio: You can also invert the order without using a comma. Example: We will sell more if we reduce prices. Negative: If we don't hurry, we will be late.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Completa la oración usando la estructura correcta del First Conditional.

questions.question: If we hire more staff, we ____ finish the project sooner. (Terminaremos).
questions.explanation: Primer Condicional: If + present, WILL + verbo.

questions.question: If the client ____ the proposal, we will start tomorrow. (Firma).
questions.explanation: Después de 'If' se usa Present Simple. Con 'the client' (he/she/it) el verbo lleva 's': signs.

questions.question: We will lose the contract if we ____ delivery. (Retrasamos).
questions.explanation: Después del 'If' va Present Simple: if we delay.

questions.question: If you ____ the report today, I will review it tomorrow. (Envías).
If the marketing campaign is successful, our sales ____. (Aumentarán).
questions.explanation: La consecuencia futura lleva WILL: will increase.

questions.question: I ____ you if I need any help. (Te llamaré).
If we don't invest in new software, we ____ behind our competitors. (Nos quedaremos).
If she ____ the interview, she will get the job. (Pasa).
questions.explanation: If + Present Simple (con 's' para she): passes.

questions.question: What ____ you do if they reject our offer?
questions.explanation: Pregunta de consecuencia futura: What will you do...?

questions.question: If the price is right, we ____ the product. (Compraremos).
If they ____ lower the price, we will not buy it. (No bajan).
If he doesn't work hard, he ____ a promotion. (No conseguirá).
questions.explanation: Consecuencia futura negativa = won't (will not) + verbo.

questions.question: I will tell the manager if you ____ the deadline. (Incumples/Te pasas de la fecha).
If we use this supplier, we ____ money. (Ahorraremos).
If the economy ____, our sales will drop. (Empeora).
questions.explanation: If + Presente (The economy = it -> lleva 's'): gets worse.

questions.question: They will sign the contract if we ____ a discount. (Ofrecemos).
If the system crashes again, I ____ IT support. (Llamaré).
If you are late for the meeting, the boss ____ angry. (Estará).
questions.explanation: Consecuencia con el verbo to be: will be.

questions.question: We ____ launch the product next month if everything goes well. (Lanzaremos).
If it rains tomorrow, we ____ cancel the outdoor event. (Cancelaremos).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo en presente o futuro (will) según el Primer Condicional.

questions.question: If we hire more staff, we ____ finish faster. (Will/Do)
If he ____ the contract, we will start. (Firmar - con S final)
We will lose money if we ____. (delay - presente)
If you send it, I ____ review it. (Will/Do)
Sales will drop if they ____ raise the price. (No - don't)
If it ____, we will cancel it. (Llover - rain con S)
If she ____ hard, she will get a promotion. (Trabaja - work con S)
I will call you if I ____ help. (Necesitar - presente)
We ____ buy it if the price is right. (Compraremos - solo el auxiliar futuro)
If the boss is angry, he ____ fire you. (Will/Do)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

options: If we reduce prices, we will sell more.
If we reduce prices, we sell more.
If we will reduce prices, we will sell more.
If we reduce the price, we will sell more.
